description: Open the SMTP sample capture file (smtp.pcap) located at /home/ga/Documents/captures/smtp.pcap in Wireshark. Right-click on an SMTP packet in the packet list and select Follow > TCP Stream to reconstruct the full SMTP email conversation. Save the complete TCP stream content shown in the Follow TCP Stream dialog to a file at /home/ga/Documents/captures/smtp_stream.txt (you can use the 'Save As' button in the dialog, or copy-paste the content).
